items.title: Why Midday and Evening results can show different dates
items.summary: Midday and Evening are separate California drawings with separate results. When the later drawing has not happened yet, or has not been published, LotteryCorner keeps showing the most recent completed result for that drawing rather than blanking the row.
takeaways: Each drawing keeps its own result date.
A row is never filled from its sibling drawing.
Check the label above the numbers before comparing a ticket.

items.title: How California draw times are shown
items.summary: Draw times on this page are shown in Pacific Time (PT), the time zone California drawings are held in. Each game row carries its own published draw time so you can tell which drawing a result belongs to.
takeaways: All times on this page are PT.
Each game row shows its own draw time.
An exact date is always shown, never “today” or “last night”.

items.title: Claiming a California prize
items.summary: LotteryCorner has its own short video on how California prizes are claimed. Because claim rules change, we point you to it rather than restating amounts or deadlines we have not re-checked.
takeaways: Official claim authority stays with the state lottery.
